name: FileUploaderBasic
description: A simple single file upload button. Unlike FileUpload, this component does not render a drag-and-drop zone — it provides a styled button that triggers the native file dialog.

notes: The visible button triggers a hidden file input on click or Enter/Space.
The hidden input receives the accept attribute for file type filtering.
Disabled state prevents the file dialog from opening and sets aria-disabled.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus).

accept.description: Comma-separated list of accepted MIME types or file extensions (e.g. 'image/*,.pdf').

onChange.description: Callback fired when a file is selected or cleared.

children.description: Custom label content for the upload button.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root wrapper element.

do: Provide descriptive button text via children (e.g. 'Upload resume' not just 'Upload').
Use the accept prop to restrict file types and prevent user errors.
Use for single file uploads — for multi-file or drag-and-drop, use FileUpload.
dont: Do not use for multi-file uploads — use FileUpload instead.
Do not use for drag-and-drop scenarios — use FileUpload instead.
Do not omit an accessible label — children text serves as the button label.
